option_relations.rationale: Squamous cell carcinoma is a type of skin cancer, but the provided leaf is specifically 'Sweat gland adenocarcinoma', which is a different type of cancer. There is no direct relation between the two.
Inverted Papilloma is a benign tumor of the nasal cavity, unrelated to 'Sweat gland adenocarcinoma'.
Malignant hidradenoma (hidradenocarcinoma) is a malignant tumor originating from sweat glands, which is synonymous with 'Sweat gland adenocarcinoma'.
Nonkeratinizing squamous cell carcinoma of the nasal mucosa with Schneiderian features is a type of squamous cell carcinoma, which is distinct from 'Sweat gland adenocarcinoma'.
